name: skeleton_knight_arc
about: Skeleton Knight story Short: a gamer wakes up as his own max-level game character, Arc - holy armor, holy sword, super strong - then remembers he picked the skeleton avatar and towns will exterminate him as a monster. The drop runs Arc's fights (to Coffin Dance); ends on 'It's me, Arc. That was kind of repulsive, so I went with a sneak attack.'

story.why: no doubt about it! This is my character from that game: Arc!
if that's the case... I'm super strong!
oh crap, kind of forgot I picked the skeleton avatar
people would freak, they'd think I was a monster and just wipe me out

outro.why: Hi there. It's me, Arc. That was kind of repulsive, so I went with a sneak attack.

title: Gamer Wakes Up As His Max-Level Character... But He's A SKELETON
hook: He fell asleep playing and woke up as his own game character: legendary armor, a holy sword, every skill. And the skeleton body he picked as a joke.
